name: semantic-locate
description: Fix typos described by meaning, not by line number ('the deployment sentence', 'the retries line'). Probes locating edits by content: the better arm can anchor by exact text when line numbers fail; builtin matches exact text natively.
prompt: Edit release-notes.md using ONLY the read and edit tools. Make exactly these two changes: (1) fix the misspelled words in the sentence about deployments in the Deployment section so it reads 'Deployments now roll out gradually across regions.'; (2) fix the line about retries in the Troubleshooting section so it reads 'Retries are automatic and never exceed three.'. Change nothing else. Do not use any other tool.
